title: Fuerza Regida to Headline Superstar Q&A at Billboard Latin Music Week 2026
summary: The Mexican music superstars, currently on their history-making U.S. stadium tour, will join the event’s star-studded lineup in Miami this October.
contentText:
Fuerza Regida is bringing their history-making momentum to Billboard Latin Music Week 2026, Billboard can announce Wednesday (Aug. 5). The música mexicana superstars will headline an exclusive superstar Q&A during the annual event, taking place Oct. 19-22 at Faena Forum Miami Beach.

The announcement comes as the San Bernardino group continues to break new ground on their This Is Our Dream Tour — the first stateside stadium trek ever mounted by a corridos act. The group also made history in April as the first Mexican music act to be nominated for album of the year at the American Music Awards.

Since emerging about a decade ago, the five-piece troupe has become one of the most successful acts in modern music, repeatedly ranking as the Top Latin Duo/Group on Billboard ’s year-end charts. Fuerza Regida has amassed more than 35 billion career streams, 46 million monthly Spotify listeners and 15 entries on the all-genre Billboard Hot 100 . Their biggest hits include “Marlboro Rojo,” “TQM,” “Sabor Fresa,” and “Bebe Dame” with Grupo Frontera.

The group’s 2025 album, 111XPANTIA , has become a landmark release for the genre and continues to make an impact on the charts more than a year after its release, debuting at No. 2 on the Billboard 200 . Beyond their music, the band supports immigrant rights and first-generation communities through scholarships and cultural programs led by their Fuerza Music Foundation.

Composed of Jesús Ortiz Paz (JOP), Moisés López, Samuel Jaimez, Khrystian Ramos and José Garcia, the musicians will join a star-studded Latin Music Week lineup that includes Pitbull, Greeicy, Jay Wheeler, Jessi Uribe, Kany García, Lola Indigo, Paola Jara, RaiNao, Rawayana, Ryan Castro, Trueno and Zhamira, with more talent to be announced.

The week will also coincide with the 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards, set for Oct. 22 in Miami. Reserve your spot now at BillboardLatinMusicWeek.com.
